center.title: Shipping Center

bulk.printPopupBlocked: The browser blocked the print window, so the labels were downloaded as a PDF instead.

center.emptyRows: No shipments match the current filters.

notifications.title: Customer shipment messages
notifications.subtitle: What the customer receives on WhatsApp at each stage. Each message is sent once per order.
notifications.emptyLineRule: Any line containing an empty field is dropped whole — so with no tracking link, the "Tracking link" line never reaches the customer.
notifications.previewEmpty: (this message renders empty with these values)
notifications.loadFailed: Could not load the message settings

center.needsActionHint: Parcels with a failed delivery attempt that are still open

pickups.title: Bosta pickup requests
pickups.subtitle: Book a Bosta courier to collect the ready parcels from the shop.
pickups.readyParcels: {{total}} parcels ready and waiting for pickup
pickups.noLocations: No pickup locations on the Bosta account. Add one from the Bosta dashboard first.
pickups.partError: Part of Bosta's data did not load: {{message}}

settlements.title: Bosta COD Settlement
settlements.subtitle: Parcels Bosta collected cash for, and the Bosta transfers that reached the bank.
settlements.backfillDone: {{count}} parcels marked as collected by Bosta

form.title: Record a Bosta transfer
form.hint: Pick the parcels in this transfer, enter the fees Bosta deducted and the net that reached the bank. Net must equal collected − fees.
form.mismatch: Net does not equal collected minus fees

bosta.unpaidTitle: Money held by Bosta, not transferred yet
bosta.unpaidHint: This figure comes from Bosta itself; compare it with what we recorded as collected before settling.
bosta.unpaidUnknown: Bosta's balance appears after the first pickup requested from the system (that is the only way Bosta reveals the account id).
bosta.unpaidUnavailable: Could not read Bosta's balance right now.
bosta.feesPrefilled: Fees were filled from Bosta's figures for the selected parcels ({{amount}}) — edit if the statement differs.
bosta.feesGap: Bosta lists {{expected}} for these parcels — a gap of {{gap}} (small pickup, returns, or something to ask about). The figure you typed is what gets expensed.

packages.title: Prepaid packages
packages.empty: No packages yet — record the first one from the form.
packages.voidConfirm: Void package #{{id}}? The money returns to the account and its shipments move to another package if one is available.

kpi.unitHint: From the oldest package with units left
kpi.uncoveredHint: Shipped since {{date}} with no package covering them — record the missing package
kpi.noPackages: Record your packages so every shipment carries its cost

form.title: Record a package
form.hint: The money leaves the account now, but it is expensed per shipment as each one ships (oldest package first). Record older packages with their dates so past shipments get their cost.
form.invalid: Enter the package price and number of shipments
form.success: Package recorded — {{count}} shipments charged to it

renew.title: Auto-renew package
renew.hint: When a package runs out, the system records a new one at the same price and size, dated at the first shipment after it, and pays it from the account — no need to remember.
renew.sinceHint: Shipments before this date are never covered automatically. To cost past shipments, pick the date of the first one (e.g. the 1st of the month).
renew.unpaid: Not paid — balance too low; it pays itself once it is enough

kpi.packageSub: Each shipment's share of its package
kpi.uncovered: {{count}} shipments without a package — cost incomplete

reconcile.title: Transfers vs Bosta's figures
reconcile.hint: {{count}} transfers in range: Bosta deducted {{fees}}; its per-parcel figures said {{expected}}.

pickups.title: Pickup days that cost a fee
pickups.hint: Days Bosta picked up fewer parcels than the threshold — the fee is deducted from the transfer and shared by that day's parcels.
